title: Pumpkin-Cream Cheese Bundt Cake
description: A pumpkin-cream cheese Bundt cake recipe, featuring a spiced pumpkin cake sweetened with maple syrup, is elevated with a decadent cream cheese filling.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 12-cup fluted tube pan (such as Bundt).
Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, salt, ginger, nutmeg, and allspice together in a large bowl; set aside.

Whisk pumpkin, brown sugar, and butter together in a separate large bowl until combined; whisk in sour cream until smooth. Whisk in maple syrup, 4 eggs, heavy cream, and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract until completely incorporated.
Stir flour mixture into pumpkin mixture until just combined.
Beat cream cheese in a bowl with an electric mixer on medium-high speed until smooth; beat in white sugar, 1 egg, and ½ teaspoon vanilla extract until thoroughly combined and smooth.
Pour ½ cake batter into the prepared pan; spoon cream cheese filling over batter. Pour remaining ½ cake batter over filling: smooth using a spatula.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, 55 to 65 minutes. Cool on a wire rack for 30 minutes. Tap the pan firmly a few times, then shake it gently to loosen the cake. Place a wire rack over the pan and invert to release cake onto the rack. Cool completely before serving.
